tspan.tspan: Checks product stock for an order line in "Confirmed". Line
s already in production and regrind lines are excluded.
Reserves stock up to the available quantity and shows the
rest as a shortage. The shortage is made by a Manufacture
work order.
Lines with an unplanned quantity (ordered − planned) are li
sted by delivery date. "Create work order" opens the form
with that quantity filled in.
Pick the target order line; a draft is created with the steps,
execution locations and inspection sheets. A warning sho
ws if a newer version exists.
A standalone work order with no order line. Only Manufactur
e is allowed; it builds up stock.
Pick order lines and quantities. The limit is what is left to a
llocate (ordered − other work orders).
The rest stays under "Not planned" in Pending work orders
and is planned by another work order.
Other lines of the same product go into one work order (one
lot). Not allowed for From stock or Regrind.
No step list; it starts with the stock-issue step. One order li
ne only, planned quantity = allocated quantity.
A material matching the product's assumed type × diameter
is preselected. A note compares material stock with the pl
anned quantity.
The shortage and next expected receipt date show in yello
w. It is only a warning; you can still save.
"No receipt scheduled" shows in red. Go to purchasing (pur
chase request → material purchase order). Saving is not blo
cked.
Combines the preparation step list (shared, always latest v
ersion) and the manufacturing step list (product × customer)
. If none exists it is created here; edits save a new version
Lines with order type Regrind fix the type. The latest regrin
d step list is used; no material or storage location.
Set the planned quantity (≥ allocated total), storage locatio
n, drawing and "allow short / over delivery", then save. St
atus Draft; the lines get the lot number.
For each in-house step, enter the planned date and whatev
er the process step master requires (work location, assigne
e, time).
"Work plans are incomplete" lists the missing steps; the re
quest cannot be sent.
If the work order approval flow has no steps, the request ca
nnot be sent.
Conditional rules (type, planned quantity) decide the steps.
Status Pending approval; the order lines are locked.
Find your turn in the Pending list and approve on the work
order screen.
Returns to Draft with the reason and unlocks. Edit and requ
est approval again.
Status Approved. The allocated order lines become In prod
uction and are unlocked.
Reserves the material for the planned quantity. The reserva
tion is made even when short and signals the need to order
Possible in Draft, Pending approval, or Approved with no st
ep started. Reservations are released; lines go back to Con
firmed and unplanned.

svg.text: Production planning — from checking stock to approving the work order
